stories.title: Iran vows to retaliate after US widens sanctions
stories.summary: Iran promised to retaliate against expanded US economic sanctions aimed at cutting off its financial lifeline, saying it expects major trading partners to resist Washington's pressure campaign.

stories.title: Netanyahu says Iran tried to kill one of his sons
stories.summary: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said Iran attempted to assassinate one of his sons, the latest escalation in the ongoing US-Israel war with Iran.

stories.title: UN halts Strait of Hormuz escort operations after vessel attack
stories.summary: The UN International Maritime Organization paused its operation escorting ships through the Strait of Hormuz after a vessel reported an attack, reigniting doubts about whether the preliminary deal to end the Iran war will hold.

stories.title: Anthropic says Claude is helping build the next version of itself
stories.summary: Anthropic disclosed that its Claude model now leads 26% of the company's own AI research and development, up from under 1% earlier in the year, moving toward recursive self-improvement under human supervision.

stories.title: Grading KC Concepcion's promising Browns debut
stories.summary: Rookie KC Concepcion flashed his playmaking ability in his first NFL game despite a costly fumble, earning an encouraging grade in the Browns' Week 1 loss.

stories.title: Browns got an uncomfortable look at what Grant Udinski could've brought
stories.summary: A look at the team coached by Grant Udinski offered an uncomfortable reminder of what the Browns might have landed when they sought a head coach of their own.

stories.title: Browns' 5 sacks allowed in Week 1 point to Deshaun Watson
stories.summary: The Browns surrendered five sacks in their season opener, and analysis points to Deshaun Watson as the main culprit behind the line's breakdowns.

stories.title: One game in, Todd Monken era confirms Browns fans' worst fears
stories.summary: A rough Week 1 already appears to be validating Browns fans' worst-case scenarios about new head coach Todd Monken's start in Cleveland.

stories.title: Ohio State mailbag: Why does Ryan Day coach 'tight'? Was the defense exposed?
stories.summary: The Athletic's Buckeyes mailbag examines why Ryan Day coaches so conservatively and whether the defense was exposed in Ohio State's 24-23 loss at Texas, as the sixth-ranked Buckeyes regroup before facing Kent State.

stories.title: Who is Patrick Havas, alleged attacker at Amy Acton campaign event?
stories.summary: NBC4 identifies Patrick Havas, the man alleged to have attacked a bystander at a campaign event for Columbus-area political figure (and former Ohio health director) Dr. Amy Acton.

stories.title: List: Central Ohio events marking anniversary of Sept. 11
stories.summary: NBC4 rounded up a list of memorial ceremonies and events scheduled in central Ohio, including the Columbus area, for reference ahead of the occasion.

stories.title: Bexley to welcome dog-friendly outdoor expansion of The Lion
stories.summary: A planned outdoor, dog-friendly expansion of The Lion is set to come to Bexley, just east of Columbus, expanding the popular spot's footprint.
